flow_ref: User story (not in any OCMS flow deck)
code_summary: ocmsadminui pages/Notice/{mode/edit/EditView, context/NoticeContext, detail/NoticeODetails (+E/U), hook/useNoticeAttachment, hook/useRepccsMediaLink}, components/form/FileInput, utils/mapping/Notice/Attachment. ocmsadminapi crud/ocmsizdb/OcmsOffenceAttachment/OcmsOffenceAttachmentController, workflows/notice_management/filedownload/downloadfile/FileDownloadController, workflows/notice_creation/core/helpers/FileProcessingHelper, workflows/notice_management/retrieval/repccsmedia. ocmsadminprivateapi framework/services/ces/CesDownloadAttachmentServiceImpl + cron-schedules-prod.properties. ocmseserviceapi, ocmseserviceui, thirdpartyapi: not relevant
note: The story asks that staff can view/download photo or video evidence in original format and quality, at any time. The attachment list, single-file download (raw bytes) and zip download exist and are clear. What is missing: there is no video player (video can only be downloaded), and video has no automatic ingest path: it comes only from staff upload or stays on the REP CCS server (opened through a URL). CES photos are stored byte-for-byte behind a decode gate; photos that fail decoding do not enter OCMS. OCMS-SR-2026-056 (Closed, Prod deployed) reports downloaded photos that could not be opened because old blobs were corrupt; the fix is in the code, but the content of PRD blobs cannot be checked from the repo. Function-based API authorization (OCMS_NOTICE_DETAIL contains /v1/offenceattachmentlist and /v1/downloads, api-authorization.properties:34-37) is not counted as a step because the story does not mention access rights; per-user function assignment: cannot verify from repo. The story status 'Fully paid' comes from the sheet, not from code.
recommendation: Claim photos (list, preview, single download, zip download). Claim video as partial: download exists, no player and no automatic ingest. Ask URA to confirm whether video from CES/PLUS is expected to land in OCMS blob

steps.step: Staff opens the Offence Details tab of a notice and its attachment list is loaded
steps.detail: Route notices/view/:notice_no/offence_details loads NOTICE_DOC (EditView.tsx:58, 88). NoticeContext.tsx:404 POSTs offenceattachmentlist {noticeNo}; OcmsOffenceAttachmentController.java:75-82 returns the attachment rows (file name, mime, size) from ocms_offence_attachment. The list has no date limit, so evidence can be opened at any time as long as the row and blob exist. Azure Blob retention policy: cannot verify from repo (no code deletes attachments in ocmsadminapi/ocmsadminprivateapi).

steps.step: Photos and videos are shown separately (Offence Photos / Offence Videos) per notice
steps.detail: NoticeODetails.tsx:121-135 (also NoticeEDetails and NoticeUDetails) shows two fields, o_photo_doc and o_video_doc. MapGetNoticeAttachment (Attachment.ts:107-128) splits the rows by whether the file name contains OFFENCE_PHOTO or OFFENCE_VIDEO, and recovers the original name by removing that prefix.

steps.step: Photo evidence from the submission is stored as-is (original format and quality)
steps.detail: The CES Download Attachments cron (enabled=true in cron-schedules-prod.properties:222, runs 07:00) reads zips from SFTP and uploads the source bytes without conversion: CesDownloadAttachmentServiceImpl.java:306-310 uploadToBlobVerified(image.getFileContent(), ...) with Content-MD5, then saves the original mime and size (316-317). The decodesAsImage gate (296) rejects files that do not decode; those stay on SFTP and never enter OCMS. OCMS-SR-2026-056 (Closed, Prod deployed): photos downloaded from the staff portal could not be opened because old blobs were corrupt; the fix (decode gate + self-heal) is in this code. Content of historical PRD blobs: cannot verify from repo. Other paths (staff upload, REPCCS, PLUS) are not covered by this step.

steps.step: Video evidence is available for the notice
steps.detail: Video enters only through two paths. (1) Staff create notice: FileProcessingHelper.java:79-83 merges photos+videos from the DTO and calls moveToPermStorage (155), so the file is moved intact into the notice blob folder. (2) REPCCS notices: the video stays on the REP CCS server; staff open its URL through POST repccs-violation-media-link (RepccsMediaLinkController.java:45-46, useRepccsMediaLink.tsx:37-60), not a file in OCMS blob. The CES cron handles images only (CesDownloadAttachmentServiceImpl.java:223, 296) and no video ingest exists in the six repos. Whether video from other sources (CES, PLUS) really does not exist: cannot verify from repo. Availability of the file on the REP CCS server: cannot verify from repo.

steps.step: Staff can view photos and videos directly on screen
steps.detail: On-screen preview works for images only: FileInput.tsx:300-306 takes FileTypeFormat['Image'] and returns false right away when the mime is not an image, while the blob is fetched through onPreview (useNoticeAttachment.tsx:35-66) and shown in a modal (312-318). The staff portal has no video player; video can only be downloaded (next step) or, for REPCCS notices, opened through an external URL.

steps.step: Staff downloads one evidence file in its original format
steps.detail: Clicking download calls POST downloads {noticeNo, fileName} (useNoticeAttachment.tsx:51-55). FileDownloadController.java:238-309 reads blob noticeAttachmentsFolder/noticeNo/fileName and returns the raw bytes (octet-stream, Content-Disposition attachment, 296-299) with no transformation; path traversal is checked at line 267. FileInput.tsx:254-270 saves the Blob under its original name (saveAs(downloaded_file, ori_name)). So format and quality equal what is stored in the blob. The quality of the blob content depends on the ingest process (see the photo step).

steps.step: Staff downloads all photos or all videos of a notice at once as a zip
steps.detail: The Download All button calls onDownloadAll (useNoticeAttachment.tsx:68-111), which POSTs downloads for each file; FileInput.tsx:240-247 then packs the original bytes into a zip (JSZip) named <noticeNo>_OFFENCE_PHOTO.zip or _OFFENCE_VIDEO.zip (NoticeODetails.tsx:126). If one file fails, an error message is shown and the other files are still zipped (FileInput.tsx:222-238).
